DISSENT
description: Featuring Lashana Lynch, dissent is an explosive new play from debbie tucker green, one of the most distinctive and influential voices in contemporary British theatre. Running time: TBC.

name: EULOGY
description: A shipping container transports you to a labyrinthine hotel that exists entirely in your mind. An immersive 360-degree audio experience from DARKFIELD. Running time: 30 minutes.

name: EUROTRASH
description: Starring Kathryn Hunter and Ben Whishaw, this production brings Christian Kracht’s internationally best-selling cult novel to the stage in a new adaptation by Colin Teevan. Running time: 2 hours including interval.

name: GIRLS
description: 2hrs no interval - 12+ - Ewa Dina, winner of the 2026 JMK Award, directs Theresa Ikoko’s powerful and award-winning story of teenage friendship under fire in Nigeria.

name: LA DISTANCE
description: Tiago Rodrigues’s La Distance is a breathtakingly beautiful and profoundly human production about separation, hope, and the bond between parent and child. Performed in French, with English surtitles. Running time: 1 hour 30 mins, no interval.

name: THELMA & LOUISE
description: Running time 2hrs 30 including interval (TBC) Amy Lennox and Rachel Tucker take to the road in a brand‑new musical version of Callie Khouri’s iconic film. This electrifying production will be directed by Trip Cullman, with music and lyrics by Neko Case.

name: WHAT'S THE F**KING POINT?
description: A dark comedy about three friends who are pulled into a spiral of medical bureaucracy. Directed by Josh Roche and Zoë Templeman-Young, and from award-winning disability led theatre company, FlawBored. Running time: approximately 70 minutes with no interval.
